title: Context-dependent psychological effects of red
statement:
The psychological effect of red is highly context-dependent, triggering avoidance/danger in achievement contexts, but approach/desire in mating or hedonic contexts.

Options:
- Avoidance / Warning: #D32F2F (Red) (fits: destructive actions, error states)
- Approach / Desire: #E91E63 (Pink/Red) (fits: dating, food delivery)
- Safe Approach: #388E3C (Green) (fits: financial growth, success states)
appliesWhen: Applies to: ecommerce, dating apps, fintech. Audience: general.

source.title: Color Psychology: Effects of Perceiving Color on Psychological Functioning in Humans
source.authors: Andrew J. Elliot; Markus A. Maier
